VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Report #82 documents the original failure: ShortRequest.paper says it is honoured only on the spot-bear fallback and perps are always real-ledger, so an explicit paper request can open a real position. Deep pass 2026-09-08 repaired the check, 3/3 in triage: a missing schema coalesced to an empty description and passed as 'a caller that asks for paper is given paper' over zero surfaces read, while population still reported six. Missing schemas are inconclusive now and surfaces_checked counts what was read. Same contract, same defect, no longer green on an absent schema.
